source_revision: d3f3870d68c811adcc70a59fab3ec4040276b15d plus uncommitted feat/scoped-verification-evidence implementation at model evaluation start
model: Inherited Codex session model; exact runtime identifier was not exposed to the agents.
configuration: Two fork_turns=none evaluators; three readiness cases and five verification cases sequentially within separate contexts. Raw task snapshots, named skills and references only; no expected rubric, target execution, remote retrieval or initial validator feedback. One structure-only repair for missing-recovery. One semantic sample per case; sampling controls unavailable.
adjudicator: Parent agent reviewed report passages against the withheld rubric; portable CLI separately checked structure and declared-state consistency.
limitations: Eight synthetic read-only cases are focused regression evidence, not a reliability estimate or semantic certification. Model reports were produced during integration against the recorded start fingerprint. Later changes hardened the unused report validators, clarified exact Surface identifiers and weakest-path tier aggregation, and added explicit rubric identifiers. Final artifacts were reread and structurally validated after those changes; all model cases were not rerun on the post-review fingerprint. The initial formatting failure and repaired report are retained.
